nodes.name: NF Cleaning
nodes.procedure: A size of 1 cm × 3 cm NF has purity 99.8% thickness 1.5 mm and aperture size 0.2-0.6 mm, was ultrasonic cleaned with 15 mL of acetone first, then washed with 15 mL of 3 M HCl solution for 10 min, and finally rinsed with water and ethanol several times.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal Ni3S2/NF Synthesis
nodes.procedure: The cleaned NF was immersed in a 20 mL stainless steel autoclave lined with polytetrafluoroethylene, which was filled with 10 mL of 0.11 g thiourea aqueous solution. Then the autoclave was sealed and keep it at 150°C for 5 h. The obtained product was washed several times with ethanol and then vacuum-dried at room temperature for 12 h to give the Ni3S2/NF.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal Ni3S2@Ni(II)-TC Synthesis
nodes.procedure: The cleaned NF was immersed in a 20 mL stainless steel autoclave lined with polytetrafluoroethylene, which was filled with 10 mL of 0.11 g thiourea aqueous solution and 0.24 g Ni(CH3COO)2. The autoclave was sealed and maintained at 150°C for 5 h. The obtained product was washed several times with ethanol and then vacuum-dried at room temperature for 12 h to give the Ni3S2@Ni(II)-TC material.

nodes.source_text: 2.3. Synthesis of Ni3S2@Ni(II)-TC ... The cleaned NF was immersed in a 20 mL stainless steel autoclave lined with polytetrafluoroethylene, which was filled with 10 mL of 0.11 g thiourea aqueous solution and 0.24 g Ni(CH3COO)2. The autoclave was sealed and maintained at 150°C for 5 h. The obtained product was washed several times with ethanol and then vacuum-dried at room temperature for 12 h to give the Ni3S2@Ni(II)-TC material.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₃S₂/NF shows nanowire arrays with length of about 2 μm. Ni₃S₂@Ni(II)-TC maintains nanowire structure unchanged.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The as-prepared electrodes were nanowire arrays with the length of about 2 um (Fig. 1b and Fig. S2) ... still maintaining the nanowire structure unchanged (Fig. 1f).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₃S₂/NF shows lattice fringes with spacing of 0.203 nm indexing to (202) plane. Ni₃S₂@Ni(II)-TC shows 0.285 nm spacing corresponding to (110) plane of Ni₃S₂ with ~3.0 nm amorphous shell.
nodes.evidence_snippet: which displayed highly ordered fringe with lattice spacing of 0.203 nm, indexing into (202) plane of Ni₃S₂ ... A thin amorphous shell with thickness of ∼3.0 nm grew on the surface of crystalline Ni₃S₂ (Fig. S7), which had clear lattice fringes in spacing of 0.285 nm, corresponding to (110) plane of Ni₃S₂ (Fig. 1g).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₃S₂/NF water contact angle 154±0.7° (superhydrophobic), bubble contact angle 0° (underwater superaerophilic). Ni₃S₂@Ni(II)-TC water contact angle 0° (superhydrophilic), bubble contact angle 153±1.7° (underwater superaerophobic).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The contact angle (CA) for water on the surface of the Ni₃S₂ in the air was 154±0.7° (Fig. 1d displays as superhydrophobicity), whereas the bubble CA (BCA) on Ni₃S₂ nanowire array underwater was 0° (Fig. 1e means supraerophilicity) ... the Ni₃S₂@Ni(II)-TC possessed a superhydrophilic/ under-water supraeraphobic surface (CA: 0° and BCA: 153±1.7° ; Fig. 1h and Fig. 1i).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₃S₂@Ni(II)-TC elemental mapping shows Ni and S concentrated in nanowire core, C and N scattered on surface.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The composition and distribution of the elements could be investigated by EDS mappings, where Ni and S were mainly concentrated in the core of the nanowire, while C and N were scattered on the surface of the nanowire (Fig. 1j).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₃S₂/NF: Ni 2p3/2 856.1 eV, Ni 2p1/2 873.5 eV (Ni²⁺); S 2p3/2 161.7 eV, S 2p1/2 163.4 eV (S²⁻). Ni₃S₂@Ni(II)-TC: Ni 2p peaks negatively shifted by 0.5 eV; new S 2p peaks at 161.3/163.8 eV (-C=S).
nodes.evidence_snippet: For Ni₃S₂/NF, the S 2p3/2 and S 2p1/2 peaks appeared at 161.7 and 163.4 eV ... the Ni 2p3/2 and Ni 2p1/2 spin-orbits of Ni₃S₂@Ni(II)-TC were negatively shifted by 0.5 eV ... The new S 2p3/2 and S 2p1/2 spinor bits were appeared at 161.3 and 163.8 eV, proving the existence of the -C=S group.

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₃S₂/NF shows bubble adhesion force of 68.2±1.2 μN during receding process. Ni₃S₂@Ni(II)-TC shows 1.2±0.1 μN.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the case of Ni₃S₂/NF, high-speed camera captured an image of adsorption phenomenon with a large stretch force of 68.2±1.2 μN (Fig. 2c) ... an extremely small stretch force of 1.2±0.1 μN on the Ni₃S₂@Ni(II)-TC electrode (Fig. 2d and Video S2).

nodes.characterization_summary: Ni₃S₂ shows standard peaks (PDF#44-1418) with Ni(0) peaks (PDF#04-0450). Ni₃S₂@Ni(II)-TC shows no diffraction peaks for Ni²⁺-thiourea complex, indicating amorphous coating.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the XRD pattern (Fig. S3), except for the three peaks of metal Ni(0) (PDF#04-0450) and the standard peak of Ni₃S₂ (PDF#44-1418), the diffraction peak of the complex formed by Ni²⁺ and thiocarbamide was not found, which reflected the amorphous properties of the complexes.
